content:
samir: Quick kickoff  co-host with NimbusWorks + AtlasHardware on Jun 30. Key ops: speaker list, demo fallbacks, and a contactless 'SnapBox' pickup for swag. Who takes which owns?
ella: I'm in for speakers + bios. Can we get final names by next Wed EOD?
yuki: I'll lead demo ops. Primary demo runs on NimbusWorks GPU cluster; fallback ladder: 1) prebuilt local container (CPU-only), 2) tiny browser-only demo (webworker), 3) 75s screen-recorded walkthrough.
paul: Marketing: need headshots + 1-line blurbs + pronouns by Tue for the landing page and email creative. Also please avoid exact latency/cost numbers unless legal approves.
samir: SnapBox idea: small contactless locker that opens with a single-use QR or short PIN. After registering attendees get a single-use PIN in email/SMS. At the pod they type PIN or scan QR and it dispenses a prepacked swag sleeve. Keeps line small.
yuki: Love the PIN option for folks who don't want to show QR on phone. Vendor supports both. What's SnapBox capacity?
venue-bot: vendor: SnapBox v1 capacity is 80 small-slots near Hall A entrance. Power + ethernet available. Delivery window Jun 28 08:00 local.
ella: If capacity < expected attendees, plan staffed overflow table with contactless scanner as fallback. Also limit 1 pack per registration to avoid hoarding.
paul: Volunteer plan: 12:30-13:30 lead @yuki, 13:30-14:15 backup @ella. NimbusWorks will provide one engineer for the first 20m.
samir: Ops asks: 1) durability check (photo of packed slots), 2) manifest with weights/dims for the courier, 3) locker mapping + slot numbers in the runbook.
yuki: I'll draft a manifest tonight. Also prepping a tiny local static site demo that runs in Chrome offline (no GPU). That should be ready for dry run.
samir: Deploy-bot: please add event to calendar and schedule dry run.
deploy-bot: calendar: "NimbusWorks x AtlasHardware: SnapBox Mini-demo" Jun 30 13:00-14:00 PT. Dry run Jun 28 09:00 PT. Invites sent.
yuki: Draft manifest:
```
- 80 SnapBox slots prefilled
- 80 sticker packs (sealed)
- 30 USB-C micro-dongles (preloaded)
- 20 pocket demo kits (boxed)
- 90 one-page quickstarts
```
I'll attach weights/dims and courier labels by EOD Fri.
paul: Run-of-show: slides due Jun 18, speaker dry run Jun 28 09:00 PT, final PDF Jun 29. Promo schedule: Jun 10 initial, Jun 24 reminder, Jun 29 last call.
ella: Moderator script will include fallback language: "If we hit any hiccups we'll switch to the local demo within 45s" and a short note to keep transitions friendly. We'll rehearse during dry run.
yuki: Tech checklist: 1x HDMI input, spare HDMI adapters, wired ethernet preferred, private hotspot as backup, bring 2x laptops (one with container, one with static demo). I'll bring a small NUC with preloaded image.
samir: For slot redemption: generate per-reg single-use PIN or QR. Vendor will upload a CSV. @ella can you confirm attendee export two days before?
ella: Yes I can. I'll export reg IDs + emails and hand to vendor on Jun 28 morning.
paul: Swag note: include a tiny promo card with a short tracking QR so we can measure post-event conversions. Also cap to 1-per-reg.
yuki: Fallback ladder summary in runbook: primary -> NimbusWorks cluster; fallback A -> local container (bootstrap <45s); fallback B -> browser-only demo; final fallback -> 75s screen-recorded walkthrough + live Q&A. Keep S3 link pinned in panelist notes.
samir: Also add an on-stage cue for the moderator to call fallback (exact phrase). We'll finalize in the dry run.
venue-bot: logistics: SnapBox installed Jun 28 08:00, locker ID: SB-A1. Vendor onsite contact: Marco (marco@snapbox.co).
ella: Volunteer shifts confirmed. I'll also coordinate a photo of the packed SnapBox for the runbook.
yuki: I'll test the PIN/QR redemption flow during dry run and bring a spare phone + mini router. Also will label each swag sleeve with slot ID and manifest card.
samir: Legal/PR reminder: do not use specific benchmark numbers in public promo or talk without signoff. Use qualitative terms.
paul: Everyone: please send bios+headshots by Tue, manifest weights by Fri, slides Jun 18, dry run Jun 28. I'll compile the landing page assets once I have the headshots.
samir: Thanks team. I'll DM owners an action checklist and post the final runbook after dry run. :white_check_mark:
